about.heading: Welcome to Braahmi Academy
paragraphs: Braahmi Academy, Managed by Braahmi Educational And Charitable Trust (R.). Specializes in encouraging quality education and holistic growth of the students.

Braahmi Academy is set up with a focused mission: to inculcate love and eagerness for learning in students, and empower them to face the challenges of life. Braahmi Academy specializes in encouraging Discipline, Morality, Patriotism, Talents and Holistic growth of the students; as they are developed not only in academics, but also encouraged to actively participate in curricular, co-curricular, science and Technology, ancient culture and tradition and pro- academic activities.

Well academic plan, technologically advanced facilities, a method of learning faster, a spirit of excellence in students. This enables them to win laurels in academics, sports, cultural and other activities at District, State and National levels.
At Braahmi Academy, learners are mentored in the right environment and best method -to succeed academically and non-academically and enjoy a rewarding career.
Braahmi Academy is currently operating from one location at Karnataka ie; Davanagere.
